title: wordpress-drupal: 2 smaller precision and sourcing points
description: 'by' says Wiz for WordPress and Drupal; Wiz also confirms Joomla: Wiz's blog: 'achieved unauthenticated remote code execution on WordPress, Drupal and Joomla'. Joomla therefore also has two parties. | Eight of the eleven applications rest on Calif alone, and its demo video is not captured: MediaWiki, Roundcube, Magento, phpMyAdmin, Nextcloud, Laravel, Symfony and WHMCS appear only in Calif's list; Calif gives versions (e.g. WordPress 7.1.2, Drupal 11.4.3) the claim omits.
